summary: Hands-on collection of 90+ AI engineering projects and tutorials on LLMs, RAG and agents, from beginner to advanced.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: AI Engineering Hub is a learning resource with more than 93 projects across skill levels. It covers LLMs, RAG, agents and more, with real-world agent applications you can implement, adapt and scale.
sixtySeconds.problem: AI engineering moves fast and tutorials are scattered. This repo collects working example projects ordered from beginner to advanced, plus a roadmap.
whoFor: Engineers looking for RAG and agent examples
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a large, MIT-licensed set of practical projects with a clear path: roadmap, beginner, intermediate and advanced.
requirements: API keys depending on the project

overview: Complete beginners start with the AI Engineering Roadmap. Beginner projects include OCR apps and simple RAG; intermediate ones cover agents and complex workflows; advanced ones include fine-tuning and production systems.
Each project lives in its own folder with its own setup, so follow the README inside the project you pick.
limitations: A collection, not one installable tool
Setup and costs vary per project
